title: Discrete vulnerability to pharmacological CDK2 inhibition is governed by heterogeneity of the cancer cell cycle
model: HCC1806 and MIA PaCa-2, TKOv3 library
contrast: INX-315 500 nM vs DMSO at passage 8, HCC1806 (2 vs 2); MIA PaCa-2 (1 vs 1)
paper_calls: HCC1806: CDK2, DYRK1A enriched, 55 depleted at FDR 0.10; MIA PaCa-2: 6 enriched
barcs_calls: 3 genes at FDR 0.10 (HCC1806 2 vs 2; 347 without the outlier DMSO culture); 6 in MIA PaCa-2
named_hits: CDK2 recovered (#1 in HCC1806, #3 in MIA PaCa-2)
verdict: BARCS finds CDK2 loss as the top INX-315 resistance hit in both lines and closely matches DrugZ (Spearman 0.93-0.94; identical MIA PaCa-2 calls). An outlier DMSO culture makes the HCC1806 2 vs 2 model conservative.
